scope.zh: 有前智慧人口的殖民地上的三件随机小事：货币库受损、非伦理实验、躁动的原住民。
scope.en: Three random incidents on colonies with pre-sapient natives: damaged currency stores, unethical experiments, fidgeting natives.

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]的一批未开化物种不知为何进入了我们殖民地外围的安保隔离区域，尽管他们在不久之后就被赶出去了，但他们已经对我们专门负责运输货币的几条星际上行运输线造成了严重的破坏。

恐怕我们要失去几百能量币。
texts.en:
A number of individuals belonging to the pre-sapient, native population of [From.GetName] somehow got into a secure compound on the outskirts of our colony. They were chased off within hours, but not before severely damaging several interstellar uplinks dedicated to currency transfers.

We fear several hundred Credits may have been lost in the ether.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这批原住民所在星球的名字。
note.en: In the game, the name of the natives' planet appears here.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]的外星生物研究员发表了一封公开信，要求当地立法部门解除对接近智慧生物进行实验的限制。

他们从科研角度出发阐述了自己的观点，警告称如果法律得不到修改，[Root.GetName]的整个科研团体的实验效率都会下降。

其中涉及的伦理问题仍有争议。
texts.en:
Xeno-researchers on [Root.GetName] have published an open letter demanding that the local legislation restricting experiments on near-sapient alien species be relaxed.

They make a convincing case for the scientific benefits, and warn that the output of the entire scientific community on [Root.GetName] will suffer unless the laws are revised.

The ethics of it all remain questionable.

label.zh: 我们会接受他们的建议。
label.en: We will accede to their demands.

tooltips.zh: 当地居民会对此十分不满。
tooltips.en: The locals will not be happy about this.

label.zh: 伦理？我们不在乎低等种群的命运。
label.en: Ethics? We care little for the fate of lesser beings.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名字。
note.en: In the game, the name of this planet appears here.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]的近智慧生物正在我们的殖民地外围闹事。[Root.Owner.GetName]的存在似乎激怒了他们，他们一直不停的在殖民地的边界和东边的某处之间来回往返。
texts.en: The near-sapient natives of [Root.GetName] are causing a ruckus on the outskirts of our colony. Something about the [Root.Owner.GetName]'s continued presence here visibly agitates them, as packs of them scurry to and fro between the settlement's borders and some unknown point to the east.

label.zh: 把他们赶走，尽量不要使用武力。
label.en: Drive them off. Gently, if possible.

label.zh: 用暴力的方式狠狠教训一下这帮愚傻的动物。
label.en: Send these dumb animals a violent message.

tooltips.zh: 那群丑陋的家伙再也不会打扰殖民地居民了。
tooltips.en: The grotesque creatures will not bother the colonists again.

label.zh: 试图找出他们去了哪里。
label.en: Try to figure out where they are going.

note.en: In the game, your empire's name appears here.

texts.zh:
一群异种学家和一队军事人员一起离开了殖民地，去追寻当地生命的行踪。

他们发现的是某种古老的播种船的残骸，这显然是某个小型[Owner.GetPreFTLLower]文明的核心，它们早就腐朽成虚无了。

[Root.GetName]的优势本地物种似乎是某种古老的播种或基因编辑程序的产物；从播种船周围的结构来看，他们显然曾经存在部落，并拥有更高的智力，甚至还有一种基本的书面语言。

我们无从猜测是什么导致了它们发生了物种层面上的退化，但它们的行为本身更有意义了。他们近乎本能地认为，我们[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]与他们最初来自星间的提升者相似。也许我们井然有序的社会唤醒了某种被它们更卑鄙的本性所淹没的形成秩序的冲动。

也许我们最终可以通过将他们提升到我们的水平来缓解他们的进化焦虑，但就目前而言，我们已经对古代太空文化对有机体的操纵有了宝贵的见解。
texts.en:
A group of xenologists departed the colony together with a contingent of military personnel, tracking the movements of the native life-forms.

What they found were the remains of some ancient seed-ship, evidently the nucleus of some small, [Owner.GetPreFTLLower] civilization, long since decayed into nothing.

The dominant native species of [Root.GetName] seem to be the product of some age-old seeding or genetic manipulation program; going by the structures surrounding the seed ship, they were once distinctly tribal, with greater intelligence and even a rudimentary written language.

We cannot begin to guess what caused their species-wide devolution, but their behavior makes more sense now. On some instinctual level they recognize us [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] as similar to their original uplifters from the stars. Perhaps our ordered society calls out to some instilled impulse to order, drowned out by their baser nature.

Maybe we can eventually ease their evolutionary anxiety by uplifting them to our level, but for now, we have gained valuable insights into the manipulation of organics by ancient spacefaring cultures.

summary.text:
# 前智慧原住民与殖民地 / Pre-sapient natives and colonies

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories

## 如何开始 How it starts

三个事件各自按平均时间（7500、7510：1200个月；7520：5000个月）在拥有非智慧人口组的殖民地触发，要求所有者是玩家、非引导智慧、非荒野帝国。
Each fires on its own mean time for human owners of colonies with non-sapient pops.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 7500 “分叉链”：原住民闯入保安区，损坏通货链路，扣300能量（不足则100）。
- 7510 “活体实验”：研究者要求放宽限制：a 无视（720天低产）/ b 同意（社会研究加成，720天不满；仅非排外）/ c 不在乎（研究+影响力并转为狂热排外；仅排外）。
- 7520 “躁动不安”：a 温和驱赶（团结，非排外）/ b 暴力驱赶（排外）/ c 追踪去向 → 7525 “遗失与遗忘”：发现古老种子船残骸。

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 三件独立；各自的选项由伦理限定。

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- AI 不触发。
